# Calendar 1.2.3

## What's changed

- Added German interface translations, date formatting, and basic offline assistant commands for creating, finding and moving events, checking availability and conflicts, and planning multiple sessions.
- Added matching flag buttons for all four languages: English, Polish, Russian and German. Saved language choices are retained; English remains the default for new installations.
- The application title follows the selected language: **Calendar**, **Kalendarz**, **Календарь**, or **Kalender**. Android launcher labels also follow the in-app language selection; some launchers may briefly cache the old label.
- Replaced the always-visible notification enable prompt with the current permission status. Android distinguishes a blocked permission from a silent reminder category and opens the relevant system settings. Status refreshes when returning to the app. Existing system mute choices are preserved.
- Renamed desktop products and all download packages to **Calendar**. Windows runs as `Calendar.exe`; Linux AppImage and Flatpak launch Calendar. Downloaded filenames and installed desktop shortcut names do not change when switching the in-app language. The live application window title does.
- Preserved the desktop data directory and application identifiers so renaming the product does not switch existing users to an empty calendar profile.
- Added regression coverage for German, language flags and persistence, notification state changes, Android launcher labels, and desktop profile selection.

The assistant remains a local rule-based system. Review proposals before confirming
calendar changes. Complex recurring series are edited in the event editor. German
support does not add German holidays.

## Downloads

- **Android:** `Calendar-1.2.3-android-test.apk` — an installable test APK signed with an Android development key; not a Google Play release.
- **Windows x64:** `Calendar-1.2.3-windows-x64-setup.exe`, `Calendar-1.2.3-windows-x64-portable.exe`, or `Calendar-1.2.3-windows-x64.zip`. These files do not have a commercial Authenticode signature.
- **Linux x64:** `Calendar-1.2.3-linux-x86_64.AppImage` or `Calendar-1.2.3-linux-x86_64.flatpak` (Flathub runtimes required).
- **Web/PWA:** `Calendar-1.2.3-web.zip` for HTTPS hosting; open online once to enable offline use.
- **Integrity:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all seven packages.

Export a calendar backup before upgrading. Android cannot update an APK signed
with a different key; uninstalling an old app deletes its local data. Sound also
depends on phone volume, Do Not Disturb, and system notification settings. Physical
phone notification delivery and camera behavior still depend on permissions,
battery policies, and hardware.
